aiSummary: In October 2026, Google google.com led search engine hosts (tablet) in Australia at 90.08% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Google google.com.au ranked second at 7.58%, followed by bing bing.com at 1.14%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engine hosts (tablet) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Google google.com leads at 90.08% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-host-market-share/tablet/australia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engine hosts (tablet) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Google google.com (90.08%), Google google.com.au (7.58%), bing bing.com (1.14%) in October 2026.
